cases.headline: More clarity. Better cost per conversion.
cases.secondaryMetric: SAR 7.26 cost per recorded conversion · 25 days
cases.challenge: A multi-specialty account needed clearer campaign structure and measurement.
cases.solution: Campaign structure by specialty and city, improved conversion definitions, refined bidding strategy.
cases.finePrint: Recorded conversions are not necessarily confirmed patient bookings.

cases.headline: Acquisition backed by measurement.
cases.challenge: Grow app acquisition while gaining visibility into post-install behavior.
cases.solution: Connected Google Ads, Play Console, Firebase and GA4 to evaluate acquisition signals.
cases.finePrint: Install volume is not a measure of user retention or in-app revenue.

cases.headline: Turning search intent into revenue.
cases.challenge: Paid visits needed stronger purchase intent and a smoother buying journey.
cases.solution: Focused high-intent exact-match keywords, search negatives, and product/checkout improvements.
cases.finePrint: Reported advertising return is not net profit.
